name: Kyststien
description_md:
Kyststien is a waymarked hiking route in Denmark covering a distance of 120.5 km. The path features 1188 m of ascent and 1191 m of descent, forming a circuit that starts and finishes at the same place.

The difficulty is hard, derived from distance and ascent, and the trail is part of a regional waymarked hiking network. Walking the route takes about 33 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. Along the way, the path passes Bornholms Museum of Arts within 200 m and Gudhjem on Bornholm within 200 m.
